name: create-organization
description: Create a new organization with a name and optional description. Returns the created organization with its system-assigned unique identifier. The organization name must be unique across the entire system.

name.description: Name of the organization (required, 1-255 characters). Must be unique across all organizations. This is the primary identifier users will see.

description.description: Optional description of the organization. Provide context about the organization's purpose, role, or any relevant details. Can be omitted if not needed.

examples.description: Create organization with name and description

errors.description: Organization with this name already exists

error.message: Organization with this name already exists

errors.description: Invalid input - name missing or too long
